economy.summary: Her campaign says the cost of living keeps rising while wages have not kept up, and she supports fighting for wages that match the cost of living, strengthening overtime protections, and pushing for paid family and medical leave.
economy.short: Supports higher wages, overtime protections, paid family and medical leave.

taxes.summary: Her campaign says rising property values push taxes higher until longtime residents can no longer afford their homes, and she supports fair assessments, expanded tax relief programs, and finding alternative revenue sources.
taxes.short: Supports fair assessments, expanded property tax relief, alternative revenue sources.

education.summary: Her campaign says every child in Philadelphia deserves a quality education regardless of zip code, and she supports adequate school funding, budget accountability, transparent safety reporting, and improved curriculum.
education.short: Supports school funding, budget accountability, safety reporting, improved curriculum.

guns.summary: Her campaign public-safety platform says safety is not achieved through policing alone but also requires prevention and investment, and lists support for harsher laws for repeat violent offenders alongside jobs, trade training, and improved street lighting.
guns.short: Supports harsher repeat-offender laws plus prevention, jobs, better lighting.

economy.summary: Her state representative site lists creating jobs through business incentives among her legislative priorities.
economy.short: Lists creating jobs through business incentives as a priority.

taxes.summary: Her state representative site says she sponsored legislation to make student loan forgiveness programs tax exempt in Pennsylvania.
taxes.short: Sponsored bill to make student loan forgiveness tax exempt.

abortion.summary: Her legislative record shows she has sponsored bills to expand public funding for abortion and to bar state funding of crisis pregnancy centers, and voted against measures restricting abortion.
abortion.short: Sponsored bills expanding abortion funding; voted against abortion restrictions.

education.summary: As Philadelphia House Delegation Chair, she voiced support for Governor Shapiro's February 2025 budget priorities, citing expanded education funding among them.
education.short: Voiced support for Shapiro's 2025 budget, citing expanded education funding.

healthcare.summary: She authored House Bill 1608, signed by Governor Shapiro in October 2024, which extends Medicaid coverage to doula services during pregnancy, delivery, and up to one year postpartum.
healthcare.short: Authored law extending Medicaid coverage to doula services.

guns.summary: She is the primary sponsor of legislation to ban 'ghost guns' by penalizing firearms and firearm parts without serial numbers, which she says are too easily obtained and drive gun violence in Philadelphia.
guns.short: Primary sponsor of legislation to ban untraceable 'ghost guns.'
